subject.title: Control UI Dashboard v2 freezes on Chrome 146 (works fine in Firefox)

question: Should this issue proceed as a live Chromium repro and narrow render-trigger fix, or should maintainers sponsor a broader safe Control UI fallback for affected Chromium builds?
rationale: The bug report is credible and maps to current shell code, but the exact current trigger is unproven and a fallback mode would add product surface beyond a strict bug fix.

options.title: Reproduce then fix the trigger
options.body: Use current-main Chrome/Chromium diagnostics to identify the shell/layout trigger and land the narrowest verified fix.

options.title: Design a safe UI fallback
options.body: Add an explicit simplified Control UI path for affected Chromium builds, accepting the broader UX and support surface.

options.title: Close after no current repro
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide a current-main Chromium reproduction cannot be obtained and the report is no longer actionable.

recommendation.title: Reproduce then fix the trigger
recommendation.body: Use current-main Chrome/Chromium diagnostics to identify the shell/layout trigger and land the narrowest verified fix.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest Dashboard v2 and responsive-refresh history for deciding whether this should be a narrow UI fix or fallback surface.
